name: Goldwell the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Goldwell welcomes travelers in Kharanos and invites them to honor the ancestors. Your visit keeps their memory alive across the snowy dwarven lands.

sections.title: A Mountain Greeting
sections.body: Beside the Thunderbrew Distillery, Elder Goldwell greets those who follow the trade path to Ironforge's gates. Weary travelers, adventurers, and locals all pass before him. He remembers the ancient days when the first mortals walked beneath Azeroth's stars.

sections.title: Honoring the Ancestors
sections.body: Goldwell is glad that mortals still remember the ancient races and their deeds. He thanks you for pausing to honor them. Then he gives you a Coin of Ancestry as a sign of his blessing.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Goldwell?
faq.answer: Elder Goldwell waits outside the Thunderbrew Distillery inn in Kharanos. The town lies along Dun Morogh's snowy road, just southwest of Ironforge's gates.

faq.q: What is the purpose of seeking out Elder Goldwell?
faq.answer: During the Lunar Festival, travelers seek Elder Goldwell to honor the world's ancient spirits. Their respect shows that mortal races still remember the sacrifices and wisdom of antiquity.

faq.q: What reward does Elder Goldwell provide?
aliases: what do i get from elder goldwell
faq.answer: Elder Goldwell gives travelers a Coin of Ancestry, a blessed token from the festival elders. It can be presented to the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade for festival goods.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde travelers?
aliases: can horde talk to elder goldwell
is elder goldwell friendly to horde
faq.answer: Yes. Goldwell and the other festival elders are neutral ancestral spirits who welcome adventurers of any faction. Horde travelers must avoid the dwarven mountaineers patrolling Kharanos.

faq.q: Why does Elder Goldwell reside in Dun Morogh?
faq.answer: The Lunar Festival elders appear across Azeroth wherever mortal civilizations have built enduring communities. Goldwell chose Kharanos to bless those living near the heart of the dwarven kingdom.

faq.q: Can you complete this quest more than once?
faq.answer: No. Each festival season, an adventurer may honor Elder Goldwell once and receive a single blessing and coin.

angles.text: As a dwarf returning from Ironforge, you meet an elder of ancient lineage outside Kharanos's premier tavern, the Thunderbrew Distillery. The visit joins timeless reverence with hometown pride.
In Alliance territory, Goldwell is one of the easiest elders for young Alliance heroes to visit on the road between Coldridge Valley and Ironforge.
To reach Goldwell, you must sneak deep into Dun Morogh, past dwarven guards and the bitter cold outside Ironforge's high gates.
